source: Lovable/Supabase export of the November 2025 community roadmap (tables phases, roadmap_items; subtasks was empty). Kept as history; the live plan is docs/roadmap and the GitHub milestones.

phases.name: Foundation & Community
phases.description: Establishing the project infrastructure, community channels, and recruiting the founding team.

items.title: Project Website
items.description: Launch the official Life Framework website with information about the project, philosophy, roadmap, and contribution opportunities.

items.title: Discord Server Setup
items.description: Create and configure the official Discord server with channels for general discussion, development updates, bug reports, feature requests, and team coordination.

items.title: Brand Identity
items.description: Establish brand identity including logo, color scheme, and visual design system for consistency across all platforms.

items.title: Build & Finalise Roadmap v1
items.description: This roadmap is itself under construction and we're activley seeking feedback on the items and prioritisation.

items.title: Founding Team Recruitment
items.description: Recruit founding team members across key roles: developers, designers, community managers, and content creators.

items.title: GitHub Repository Setup
items.description: Set up the main GitHub repository with proper structure, README, contributing guidelines, and issue templates.

items.title: Development Environment Setup
items.description: Establish development environment standards, tooling requirements, and build pipeline for contributors.

items.title: License & Legal
items.description: Finalize MIT license, contributor agreements, and establish clear legal framework for the open-source project.

items.title: Documentation Foundation
items.description: Create initial documentation structure and getting started guides for contributors and users.

phases.name: Core Systems
phases.description: Building the fundamental gameplay systems including character creation, tutorials, and basic survival mechanics.

items.title: Character Creation System
items.description: Player can choose their spawn point from 2 options.

items.title: Basic Resource Gathering
items.description: Allow players to gather raw materials, starting with apples.

items.title: Basic Resource Processing
items.description: Starting with processing simple apples into apple juice.

items.title: Persistence
items.description: Server state saved across server restarts inside a external database.

items.title: Currency & Shop System
items.description: Develop the in-game economy foundation with currency and item stores.

phases.name: Basic Economy
phases.description: Implementing the full economy system with resource gathering, crafting, trading, and employment opportunities.

items.title: Tutorial & Onboarding
items.description: Create an interactive tutorial system with in-game prompts, text instructions, and hands-on challenges to introduce players to game mechanics and features.

items.title: Vehicle Ownership System
items.description: Vehicle registration, keys (multiple per vehicle) with vehicle stores.

items.title: Basic Housing System
items.description: Allow players to purchase houses for persistent item storage. Also basic raiding system for police.

phases.name: Law Enforcement
phases.description: Creating comprehensive law enforcement systems and player-run organizations for social gameplay.

items.title: Police Department Infrastructure
items.description: Build police station. Create rank progression system from patrol officer to detective.

items.title: Arrest & Detention System
items.description: Create arrest mechanics with handcuffs and tasers. Include transport to jail and prison where players serve time.

items.title: Crime Tracking System
items.description: Develop crime list with severity levels, penalties and punishment. Include crime reporting via interface, chat, or hotline.

items.title: Search & Frisk System
items.description: Allow officers to search suspects for contraband.

items.title: Fine & Ticket System
items.description: Create interface for issuing fines and tickets. Integrate with crime system and player records.

items.title: Player Organizations Framework
items.description: Allow players to create and manage businesses, gangs, clubs, or political groups. Include registration, naming, membership management, and rank systems.

phases.name: Advanced Features & Polish
phases.description: Adding advanced systems like vehicle ownership, housing, dynamic events, and polishing the overall experience.

items.title: Police Equipment System
items.description: Implement full police equipment including weapons (handguns, shotguns, rifles), protective gear (riot gear, vests), tasers, handcuffs, flashlights, and surveillance tools.

items.title: Housing System
items.description: Allow players to purchase and customize houses and apartments. Include interior decoration, storage, and property management.

items.title: Dynamic Events System
items.description: Implement random events like natural disasters, terrorist attacks, and special scenarios that affect the game world.

items.title: Immersion Polish
items.description: Enhance atmosphere with detailed animations, audio effects, visual feedback, and environmental storytelling to maximize immersion.

items.title: Balance & Feedback Loop
items.description: Continuous balancing of economy, difficulty, character abilities, and resource availability based on player feedback and testing.
